title: UDF using political power to target SFI leaders in Kozhikode: CPI(M)
summary: Non-bailable sections under the BNS were invoked against SFI district leaders related to a campus incident, says CPI(M) district secretariat

title: Teppotsavam on temple tank marks end of Dasara festivities at Srisailam
summary: The Goddess appears as Sri Bhramaramba Devi on the last day of the festival

title: Tamil Nadu rains LIVE: CM Vijay to chair meeting on Northeast monsoon preparedness
summary: A fresh system, over the Bay of Bengal, is likely to sustain intense rainfall across Tamil Nadu till October 26, the Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) said

title: Gold smuggled from Bangladesh seized near Vijayawada; five arrested
summary: Three men carrying 3.1 kg of gold concealed around their waists were intercepted aboard a Hyderabad-bound bus, while two others were caught transporting foreign currency hidden inside a Scorpio.

title: Right hand of Rani Channamma statue in Kittur falls off
summary: People demand that the statue be repaired in three days, before the inauguration of Kittur Utsav on October 23

title: Two injured in suspicious blast at under-construction building in Bengaluru
summary: According to a preliminary investigation, suspicious items were found in a bag at the spot and have been sent for forensic examination.

title: Supreme Court sets aside Kerala HC order in CMRL payoff case, stays FIR probe for 7 days
summary: The Supreme Court clarified that it had made no observations on the merits of the FIR. It also refrained from expressing any opinion on the validity of a subsequent Enforcement Case Information Report (ECIR) registered against the petitioners

title: Children in Kochi begin formal learning on Vijayadashami as CM Satheesan leads event
summary: Holding the hands of around 25 children at the ceremony in Kochi, the CM guided them to write  ‘Harishree’ in Malayalam with their index finger on rice-filled platters
